title: The Pixel Path: From Browser to Backend (ish)

title: The Secret Sauce: Drive-Thru Data
description: The true magic? Content lives in Google Drive, making it incredibly easy to manage without database headaches. `src/siteConfig.js` handles all the unique branding.
panel_text: No pricey databases here. We leverage Google Drive for content, and `src/siteConfig.js` for school branding. Genius, right?
speech_bubble: No pricey databases here. We leverage Google Drive for content, and `src/siteConfig.js` for school branding. Genius, right?

    C --> D(src/siteConfig.js)

title: Your Turn, Padawan: Contributing Made Easy
description: Want to jump in? Clone the repo, check `README.md`, tweak `src/siteConfig.js`, and `npm install`. Deployment is automated via `.github`.
panel_text: Ready to contribute? `README.md` is your bible. Change `src/siteConfig.js` for branding, and let `.github` do the rest!
